title: Environment, toolboxes and configuration

implementation.ui: Views/SettingsView.cs (environment section, reload, resource check, preset picker, findings), Views/OgPageBase.cs (DiagnosticsView), Views/WellboreDemoView.cs (environment source on the visual screen)

gates.AC-1 register-before-load: pass — A_toolbox_section_is_validated_only_after_the_toolbox_is_registered: an unregistered probe section yields no line; registering the probe makes Validate() report it. Plus Registering_every_toolbox_leaves_none_missing and Registering_twice_does_not_duplicate_a_toolbox.
gates.AC-2 path on every visual screen: pass — SettingsView shows file/defaults/preset plus country, units and toolbox counts; WellboreDemoView prints 'Environment: <source>' on the visual screen.
gates.AC-3 findings with section and key: pass — SettingsView renders '[severity] source: message' lines (up to 8) and an EnvironmentFindings count.
gates.AC-4 country preset applied and labelled: pass — LoadCountryPreset uses CountryPresets.Load ('extends: country:XX'), sets IsUsingCountryPreset, and both the Settings and Wellbore pages label it as a preset. A_country_preset_is_applied_and_labelled_as_a_preset, An_unknown_country_preset_is_refused.
gates.AC-5 reload rebuilds open views and repo: pass — OgWellboreLifetime.Reload/ApplyCountryPreset raise EnvironmentChanged; the shell re-creates the current page from the page factory; LastChangeSummary ('<source> · N warning(s) · M finding(s)') is shown in Settings. A_reload_announces_the_change_and_describes_it.
gates.AC-6 missing resource disables the depen: pass at the service layer — CheckResources_reports_a_missing_folder_for_a_registered_toolbox proves a registered toolbox's failing Check produces 'toolboxes.<name>: <reason>'; ToolboxAvailability/IsToolboxUsable turn that into per-toolbox usability and Settings shows 'X/Y toolbox(es) usable'. No toolbox screen exists yet to disable, so the consumer arrives with VSB-04/05 and the ENG features.
gates.toolboxResourceCheck: pass — CheckResources_reports_a_missing_folder_for_a_registered_toolbox covers both the failing and the satisfied case.

limits: AC-6 is enforced and tested at the store; nothing in the UI is hidden yet because there is no toolbox screen in the desktop.
The country preset was exercised for KW only; the other 61 presets are unverified.
The reload rebuild was verified by construction and event wiring; no window was shown, so the visual rebuild is unobserved.
The settings page was constructed by the smoke run, not driven by clicks.
